title: Trajectory Mapper

brief.one_line_thesis: A prototype concept focused on mapping trajectories.
success_criteria: Successfully demonstrate the core functionality of trajectory mapping
open_questions: What does the '#NU' tag signify in the input?
Who is the primary persona using the Trajectory Mapper?
What kind of trajectories are being mapped (e.g., career, physical/spatial, data, financial, educational)?
What specific moment in the user journey does this prototype demonstrate?
What are the specific success criteria for stakeholders to believe this experience works?
Are there any specific brand, platform, or regulatory constraints?

screens.purpose: Introduce the Trajectory Mapper and prompt the user to begin their first mapping exercise.
screens.persona_state: Curious but uncertain about the future; seeking clarity and direction.

screens.purpose: Collect the starting point (current state) and destination (target state) to anchor the map.
screens.persona_state: Focused and reflective; actively defining their goals.

screens.purpose: Provide system feedback and maintain engagement while the trajectory algorithm processes.
Display the generated trajectory as an interactive, chronological node-based visualization.
screens.persona_state: Engaged, analytical, and relieved to see a structured path.

screens.purpose: Provide deep-dive details on a specific milestone within the trajectory.
screens.persona_state: Information-seeking; evaluating the feasibility of a specific step.

behavior_per_state.default: Solid primary color background, bold white text.
behavior_per_state.hover: Background brightness increases by 10%, cursor changes to pointer.
behavior_per_state.active: Scale transforms to 0.98, slight inner shadow applied.
behavior_per_state.loading: Text fades out, replaced by a looping circular SVG spinner.
behavior_per_state.error: Background shifts to red, subtle horizontal shake animation.
behavior_per_state.success: Background shifts to green, spinner replaced by a checkmark icon.

behavior_per_state.default: Circular element with a 2px solid border and white fill.
behavior_per_state.hover: Border thickness increases to 4px, cursor changes to pointer, tooltip appears.
behavior_per_state.active: Fills with primary color, connected path lines glow.
behavior_per_state.loading: Skeleton state with a shimmering gradient fill.
behavior_per_state.error: Red border, exclamation mark icon inside.
behavior_per_state.success: Solid green fill, checkmark icon inside.

motion_contract.encodes: The progression of time and effort from the start point to the end point; lines draw themselves sequentially from left to right.
Hierarchy and temporary focus; the panel slides in from the right edge over the canvas, indicating it is a secondary layer of detail.
System activity and progress; text strings crossfade sequentially to reassure the user that complex background processing is occurring.
Interactivity and selection readiness; the node border darkens to signal it can be clicked for more information.

critique.summary: The prototype successfully implements the core trajectory mapping flow, correctly applying the design system tokens and state machine logic. However, it requires refinement to fix missing React imports, implement missing micro-interactions (node tooltips and active path glow), and address keyboard accessibility for interactive elements.

issues.description: Missing standard React, Framer Motion, and Lucide React imports, which will cause the code to fail upon execution.
issues.fix: Add `import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';`, `import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';`, and `import * as lucide from 'lucide-react';`.

issues.description: The Trajectory Node hover state is missing the specified tooltip.
issues.source_of_truth: Interaction Spec > Micro-interactions > Trajectory Node > hover
issues.fix: Add an `<AnimatePresence>` block inside the node that renders a tooltip when `isHovered` is true and `isActive` is false.

issues.description: The active state for the Trajectory Node specifies that 'connected path lines glow', but the active path line only changes color and thickness.
issues.source_of_truth: Interaction Spec > Micro-interactions > Trajectory Node > active
issues.code_location: InteractiveMap component > Active Path Overlay SVG line
issues.fix: Apply a `filter: drop-shadow(...)` to the active `<motion.line>` to create the glow effect.

issues.description: Trajectory Nodes are interactive but use a `<div>` with an `onClick` handler, making them inaccessible to keyboard users.
issues.fix: Change the interactive `<motion.div>` to a `<motion.button>` and remove default button styling to ensure native focus and keyboard activation.

issues.description: Input fields and the timeline slider lack explicit programmatic labels linking the `<label>` to the `<input>`/`<textarea>`.
issues.fix: Use `React.useId()` to generate unique IDs for inputs and link them using `htmlFor` on the labels. Add an `aria-label` to the range input.

research_goal: Identify a comprehensive new strategy for co-op based on the current statement of work for NU, prior projects with NU, and fresh industry analysis of experiential learning and co-op engagement tactics to improve learner's chances of gaining meaningful experiential learning opportunities from pre-enrollment to graduate school
